item.title: Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery announce $110 billion deal
item.description: A massive $110 billion merger has been signed between Warner Bros Discovery and Paramount Skydance.

item.title: Woman behind multimillion dollar liens arrested for filing false documents, LAPD says
item.description: Rita Ortiz, the woman who filed numerous multimillion liens on homeowners on Benedict Canyon Drive, has been arrested.

item.title: Los Angeles radio legend Uncle Joe Benson dies at 76
item.description: L.A. radio legend Uncle Joe Benson has died at the age of 76. Known for a deep, rumbling voice and wide knowledge of rock music, Benson spent more than 30 years at 95.5 KLOS.

item.title: 14-year-old boy faces long road to recovery after he was struck by SUV on downtown LA sidewalk
item.description: The parents of a 14-year-old boy described his recovery after he and others were struck by an SUV that jumped a curb in downtown Los Angeles.

item.title: SoCal weather: Warm Saturday on tap, followed by cooldown
item.description: Southern California is expected to see another very warm Saturday before temperatures begin to cool.

item.title: Disaster as fencing wire gets tangled in spinning car wash in North Carolina
item.description: The first rule of going to the car wash with your truck is make sure there's nothing in the bed. A North Carolina man found that out the hard way.

item.title: California snowpack gets February boost but remains below average statewide
item.description: After a series of February storms, California's snowpack received a much-needed boost but it's not enough to bring the state back to average for this time of year.

item.title: Big Bear's famous bald eagles Jackie and Shadow welcome second egg after nest attack
item.description: Big Bear's famous bald eagle couple, Jackie and Shadow, welcomed another egg to their nest.

item.title: Death of 12-year-old girl days after school altercation sparks homicide investigation in Reseda
item.description: Los Angeles police are investigating the death of a 12-year-old girl, days after an altercation at school, as a homicide.

item.title: Israel's defense minister says his country has attacked Iran and declares a state of emergency
item.description: Israel launched a daylight attack Saturday on Iran's capital, with a cloud of smoke rising from the city's downtown.
